name: smwgraphics-nekketsu-street-basket-ganbare-dunk-heroes-title-screen
title: Nekketsu! Street Basket: Ganbare Dunk Heroes - Title Screen
description:
The background used in the title screen of one of last Kunio-Kun game for the NES.

Uses palette 0, but won't affect status bar colors.
Also comes with a parallax scrolling effect, and 2 palettes (the FCEUX palette and the NTSC palette). Note that if you use the parallax scrolling effect, the level shouldn't make the background scroll vertically!
